fires_exactly_when: A product detail page finishes rendering with a resolved item_id. Not on a list card, not on a hover, not on a modal quick-view
value_source: Listed price, not the discounted total
common_error: Fired on every card in a listing, which multiplies the count by the page size and makes the view-to-cart ratio look catastrophic
vn_note: Most traffic arrives inside the Facebook or Zalo in-app browser, where a session restarts more often than on desktop, so session-scoped counts run high
what_it_does_not_prove: Interest. A page can render because a crawler asked for it or because the visitor mis-tapped

fires_exactly_when: The cart write succeeds, in the response handler. Not on the button click
value_source: Quantity times unit price at the moment of the write
common_error: Bound to the click handler, so a failed write, a double tap and a rage tap all count
vn_note: Marketplace sellers have no cart event at all. The cart lives inside Shopee or TikTok Shop and cannot be instrumented from outside
what_it_does_not_prove: Intent strong enough to price against. Carts get used as wishlists

fires_exactly_when: The first checkout step renders with a non-empty cart
value_source: Cart subtotal before shipping and discount
common_error: Re-fired on every step of a multi-step checkout, which pushes it above add_to_cart
vn_note: A large share of orders never reaches a checkout page because they are placed in chat. Instrument the chat handoff or this stage reads as a collapse

fires_exactly_when: The order record is created server-side and returns an order id. Fire it from the server, not from the thank-you page
value_source: Order total excluding shipping and tax, unless the whole plan agrees otherwise in writing
common_error: Fired on the thank-you page, so a refresh double-counts and a customer who closes the tab mid-redirect is never counted at all
vn_note: On cash on delivery this event is an order request and not revenue. Pair it with order-delivered or every efficiency figure is overstated by the cancellation rate
what_it_does_not_prove: Revenue. It proves an order was created

fires_exactly_when: A person or a rule confirms the order is real and shippable, usually after the confirmation call
value_source: Confirmed order total, after the call changed it
common_error: Not instrumented at all, so nobody can see the gap between orders placed and orders worth shipping
vn_note: The confirmation call is standard practice here and it is where duplicate and prank orders get removed. Skipping this event throws away the cleanest number in the funnel
what_it_does_not_prove: Delivery. A confirmed order can still be refused at the door

fires_exactly_when: The carrier reports successful delivery and, on cash on delivery, the money is collected
common_error: Assumed equal to purchase, which is the largest single overstatement available in a cash-on-delivery funnel
vn_note: This is the event that makes a Vietnamese report honest. Compute the ratios that decide budget on it, and report purchase-to-delivered on its own line
what_it_does_not_prove: That the order survives the return window

fires_exactly_when: A return or refund is accepted and the money leaves
value_source: Amount refunded, carried as a negative
common_error: Recorded in accounting and never joined back to the campaign, so the channel that sells the most returns keeps its budget
vn_note: Reason codes decide more than the rate does. Wrong size is a listing problem, damaged in transit is a carrier problem, and the two get budgeted differently
what_it_does_not_prove: Dissatisfaction. A return can be a size exchange

fires_exactly_when: A form submission is accepted server-side and passes validation
value_source: Leave empty unless a verified average lead value exists
common_error: Given an invented monetary value so a return figure can be computed, which promotes an assumption to a reported number
vn_note: Forms convert badly against chat here, so a form-only lead plan usually ends up measuring the wrong channel
what_it_does_not_prove: A contactable person. Validation is not verification

common_error: Reported as a call. It is a tap on a phone number and nothing more
vn_note: Worth pairing with a tracked number, because the tap and the connected call are different events and only one of them is a lead
what_it_does_not_prove: That a call happened, connected or was answered

fires_exactly_when: A link to a Zalo Official Account or chat is activated
common_error: Treated as the end of the funnel, when everything that decides the sale happens after it and outside the website
vn_note: The click is the last thing a website can see. Whether the conversation joins back to the campaign is a Zalo question, answered in data/attribution-windows.csv rather than assumed
what_it_does_not_prove: A conversation. The app may not open and the message may never be sent

fires_exactly_when: A link or plugin that opens Messenger is activated
common_error: Added to Meta's own messaging conversion for the same person in the same report, so one thread counts twice
vn_note: Messenger and Zalo split by audience age and by category, so instrument both rather than the one the team happens to prefer
what_it_does_not_prove: A reply. Opening a thread is not starting a conversation

fires_exactly_when: A link out to Shopee, Lazada or TikTok Shop is activated
common_error: Promoted to a conversion because it is the last measurable step, which quietly redefines the goal as leaving the site
vn_note: The hardest wall in a Vietnamese measurement plan. What the platform reports back to the seller decides whether this click can ever be joined to an order
what_it_does_not_prove: An order. The visit continues somewhere this plan cannot see

fires_exactly_when: A directions or map link is activated
common_error: Added to the Business Profile's own directions metric for the same visit, in the same table
vn_note: Most local intent resolves inside Google Maps and never touches the website, so this number is a fraction of the real one and cannot be compared with it

fires_exactly_when: Cumulative watch time on one video passes a threshold the plan names once and then keeps
common_error: Compared across platforms whose definitions of a view differ by an order of magnitude
vn_note: A platform view count and this event answer different questions, so they never belong in the same column of a report
what_it_does_not_prove: Attention. Autoplay with the sound off clears most thresholds

fires_exactly_when: A double opt-in is confirmed, not when the address is typed
common_error: Fired at form submit, so reported list growth is larger than the list
vn_note: Carry the consent source as a parameter. Law 91/2025/QH15 replaced Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on 1 January 2026 and a list without provenance cannot be defended under either
what_it_does_not_prove: Permission to send anything the consent text did not describe
